title: Concept: Resolution without metadata source policy
description: settings.gradle declares a setup that accepts whatever metadata variant a repository serves, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a setup that accepts whatever metadata variant a repository serves.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through settings.gradle (gradle).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a setup that accepts whatever metadata variant a repository serves.
